title: Feet first: Eric Cantona's kung-fu kick

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"; the settings of plea2005 (STYLE_BIBLE rule 68)

post:
Selhurst Park, 25 January 1995. Eric Cantona is sent off, a fan comes down to the front, and Cantona goes over the barrier feet first. Eight months out, community service, and one sentence about seagulls.

#cantona #ericcantona #manchesterunited #manutd #crystalpalace #premierleague #footballhistory #football #footballtiktok

phrases.text: Eric Cantona. Manchester United's number seven. On a January night in 1995, he jumped into the crowd, feet first.
phrases.say: [intrigued] Eric Cantona. ... Manchester United's number seven. ... On a January night in nineteen ninety-five... he jumped into the crowd... feet first.

phrases.text: Selhurst Park, away at Crystal Palace. Three minutes into the second half, Cantona kicks out at defender Richard Shaw. The referee shows him red.
phrases.say: Selhurst Park, away at Crystal Palace. Three minutes into the second half, Cantona kicks out at defender Richard Shaw. ... [firmly] The referee shows him red.

phrases.text: As he walks along the touchline, a Palace fan runs down to the front and shouts abuse at him.
phrases.say: As he walks along the touchline... a Palace fan runs down to the front... and shouts abuse at him.

phrases.text: Cantona stops. He turns. And he launches himself over the barrier, kung-fu style.
phrases.say: [tense] Cantona stops. ... He turns. ... And he launches himself over the barrier... kung-fu style.

phrases.text: United fine him £20,000. The FA bans him for eight months. A court sentences him to two weeks in prison, cut on appeal to community service, coaching children.
phrases.say: United fine him twenty thousand pounds. The FA bans him for eight months. A court sentences him to two weeks in prison... cut on appeal to community service: coaching children.

phrases.text: Then he faces the press: When the seagulls follow the trawler, it's because they think sardines will be thrown into the sea. Thank you very much. And he walks out.
phrases.say: Then he faces the press. ... [calmly] When the seagulls... follow the trawler... it's because they think sardines will be thrown into the sea. ... Thank you very much. ... [amused] And he walks out.

phrases.text: Two years later, he lifts the Premier League trophy. Then he walks away.
phrases.say: [warmly] Two years later, he lifts the Premier League trophy. [quietly] Then he walks away.
